| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium |

| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Accessible reviews of social and personality psychology — Wiley Compass series style; broader-audience integrative reviews accessible to non-specialists |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong — review venue)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must be **accessible reviews bridging social and personality psychology** to non-specialist audiences. Compass series emphasizes clarity over depth.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Empirical work redirected to JPSP / PSPB / J Personality. Dense specialist reviews redirected to PSPR.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Original empirical work
- AI use without disclosure per Wiley policy
- Dense specialist reviews (consider PSPR)

### Soft Tax

Low for review tradition authors comfortable with accessible writing.

### Best Suited For

- Accessible social-personality psychology reviews
- Pedagogically-oriented synthesis
- Broader-audience integrative reviews
- Cross-discipline social-personality syntheses

### Not Recommended For

- Original empirical work
- Pure specialist theoretical reviews (consider PSPR)
- Pure qualitative

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Personality and Social Psychology Review](./personality-and-social-psychology-review.md) | SAGE SPSP peer for theoretical reviews |
| 2 | [Review of General Psychology](./review-of-general-psychology.md) | APA Division 1 integrative |
| 3 | [Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin](./personality-and-social-psychology-bulletin.md) | If reframed as empirical-test |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from PSPR as "too accessible," SPPC is the Wiley Compass home for broader-audience reviews.
